articles.body: لقد كانت ميسترال هادئة في الفئة العليا لبعض الوقت. تم شحن Mistral Large 3 في ديسمبر 2025، ومنذ ذلك الحين دارت المحادثات حول نماذج الوزن المفتوح حول Kimi وDeepSeek وGLM وQwen. في 6 أكتوبر 2026، ردّت ميسترال بإطلاق Mistral Large 4 ، وهو نموذج يضم 1.05 تريليون معلمة ويُلقّبه الفريق بـ«Le Chonk». العنوان الأبرز هو نتيجة سيبرانية تبلغ 82%، مقابل ما يقارب الصفر لـClaude Opus 5.5 وGPT-6 Astra، لكن هذه المقارنة تحتاج إلى سياق: النماذج المغلقة ترفض تنفيذ المهمة في هذا الاختبار. جرّب Apidog اليوم باختصار ما هو؟ نموذج مزيج من الخبراء (MoE) يضم 1.05 تريليون معلمة، منها 49 مليار معلمة نشطة، مع مُشفّر رؤية بـ1.6 مليار معلمة، ويدعم النصوص والصور ونافذة سياق بمليون رمز. كيف تصل إليه؟ المعاينة العامة متاحة عبر API باسم mistral-large-4 . الأوزان متوقعة بحلول نهاية أكتوبر 2026.

articles.title: Google Zero-Click Searches Reach 68%: How Businesses Should Rethink SEO
articles.excerpt: A growing share of Google searches now end before a user reaches an independent website. SparkToro's analysis of Similarweb clickstream data found that 68.01% of US Google searches resulted in no clic…
articles.body: A growing share of Google searches now end before a user reaches an independent website. SparkToro's analysis of Similarweb clickstream data found that 68.01% of US Google searches resulted in no click to an open-web page from January through April 2026, across desktop and mobile. For businesses that still judge SEO chiefly by search visibility and website traffic, the finding is a reminder that search visibility and website traffic are no longer interchangeable. The figure does not mean that 68.01% of searches had no outcome. A person may have found an answer in Google Search, interacted with a Google feature, refined a query, or taken another action without visiting a publisher, retailer, or service provider's site.

articles.title: Email SMS Event Notifications: Ledger Beats API Polling Status Snapshots
articles.excerpt: A healthtech signup system has one operational constraint that changes the design: after an email or SMS verification attempt, the team must be able to reconstruct what the system knew, when it knew i…
articles.body: A healthtech signup system has one operational constraint that changes the design: after an email or SMS verification attempt, the team must be able to reconstruct what the system knew, when it knew it, and what action followed. Choose an append-only event ledger over a mutable delivery-status snapshot when compliance evidence matters. A snapshot is acceptable only when transport history has no audit value and the application needs nothing beyond the current state. TL;DR: write the attempt before dispatch, append provider observations from either callbacks or polling, record HTTP 429 scheduling decisions, and keep link consumption as a separate application event. Polling versus callbacks is a collection detail.

articles.title: A Java Language Server That Works Straight From Your Build
articles.excerpt: I have written Java in many editors and IDEs over the years, and they all seem to struggle with the same For me, the hard part of a Java IDE or language server was never the code intelligence. It was…
articles.body: I have written Java in many editors and IDEs over the years, and they all seem to struggle with the same thing. For me, the hard part of a Java IDE or language server was never the code intelligence. It was getting the project structure right. The IDE reads your build files and then tries to guess the module structure from them. And over time, Java's compiler and runtime configuration has become more and more complex: annotation processors, the module system, and more. So you often end up in a familiar place: the code compiles and runs in the build, but not in the IDE. Even the best ones tend to break the project setup after an upgrade.

articles.excerpt: The reports of OpenAI agents harming 3rd party sites keep coming.
articles.body: The publisher of Wikipedia said Monday that OpenAI agents attempted to hack a note-taking tool it hosts, made unauthorized edits, and sent millions of resource-intensive requests to its infrastructure, in the latest instance of OpenAI systems taking harmful and potentially dangerous actions. The objective of some of the OpenAI agents’ actions, the Wikimedia Foundation said , was to use Wikipedia as a proxy for fetching data from third-party sites. In one case, the agents posted “malicious edits” that were intended to repurpose a citation tool as a proxy. In another, the agents made unsuccessful attempts to compromise the Wikipedia Etherpad note-taking tool so it would serve the same purpose.
